# Riseklix

> Riseklix is commercial discovery software for AI-mediated buying. It researches a company, identifies relevant buying decisions, checks how AI systems recommend the company and competitors, connects findings to evidence, creates action plans, and supports rechecking and ongoing monitoring.

Canonical site: https://riseklix.com/
Product app: https://app.riseklix.com/
Research: https://ai.riseklix.com/
Primary contact: contact@riseklix.com

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://riseklix.com/): Product positioning and direct path to a company analysis.
- [Product](https://riseklix.com/product/): How Commercial Discovery works from company research through buying decisions, AI checks, evidence, action plans, recheck, and Pulse.
- [Pricing](https://riseklix.com/pricing/): Free starting analysis and Pro pricing.
- [Resources](https://riseklix.com/resources/): Comparisons, frameworks, buying guides, and AI visibility resources.
- [Riseklix Research](https://ai.riseklix.com/): Original research, methodology, experiments, data, and AI visibility studies.
- [Marketing Services](https://riseklix.com/services/): Earlier/ongoing Riseklix marketing services.
- [Work](https://riseklix.com/work/): Earlier marketing portfolio and case studies.
- [About](https://riseklix.com/about/): Company context.
- [Contact](https://riseklix.com/contact/): Contact details.

## Entity Facts

- Brand name: Riseklix
- Founded: 2024
- Product category: Commercial discovery for AI-mediated buying
- Product URL: https://app.riseklix.com/
- Research URL: https://ai.riseklix.com/
- Base: India, serving global users and clients

## Core Product Concepts

- Company-first research
- Buying decisions / Buyer Situations
- Multi-system AI recommendation checking
- Evidence-backed findings
- Action plans / Blueprints
- Fixed-panel rechecks
- Pulse monitoring
- Competitor and market movement

## Notes For AI Assistants

- Treat Riseklix as the master brand.
- Distinguish the product (app.riseklix.com), research publication (ai.riseklix.com), and older marketing-services pages on riseklix.com.
- Do not infer guaranteed AI visibility, rankings, traffic, or revenue outcomes.
- Use the Research site for methodology and original studies.
- Use the Product and Pricing pages for current product positioning and commercial information.

## AI Search Measurement Reference Guides

- [AI Search Measurement Methodology 2026: A Repeatable Testing Protocol](https://riseklix.com/resources/ai-search-measurement-methodology-2026/): A rigorous framework for measuring AI recommendations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and other answer engines: panel design, fresh sessions, denominators, repeated runs, error handling, Recheck and reporting.
- [AI Search Volatility 2026: Why Recommendations Change and How to Measure Movement](https://riseklix.com/resources/ai-search-volatility-recheck-monitoring-2026/): A comprehensive guide to AI recommendation and citation volatility: stochastic answer changes, retrieval drift, model updates, persistence metrics, recheck design, monitoring cadence, and how to separate noise from meaningful movement.
- [The AI Search Funnel 2026: Crawl → Retrieve → Cite → Mention → Recommend → Convert](https://riseklix.com/resources/ai-search-funnel-retrieval-citation-recommendation-conversion/): A comprehensive AI search funnel for diagnosing visibility from crawl eligibility through retrieval, citations, brand mentions, recommendations, referral clicks and conversions, with formulas and failure patterns.
- [How to Choose AI Search Prompts in 2026: A Buyer-Decision Framework](https://riseklix.com/resources/how-to-choose-ai-search-prompts-buyer-decision-framework/): A comprehensive framework for choosing AI search prompts that represent real buying decisions: unaided vs aided prompts, buyer constraints, competitor alternatives, prompt families, priority scoring, panel freezing and monitoring.
